title: Minnesota’s Democratic Senate Primary Pits Angie Craig Against Peggy Flanagan
summary: The Senate primary race in Minnesota will be the latest test of left-wing energy in the party, in a state that was convulsed by the Trump administration’s deadly immigration crackdown this winter.
